drafted_from: tool:place-pursuits-on-a-life-map row in tool-rows.json, do-work/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map.mjs, src/life-map.mjs, read-data/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map.json and test/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map.test.mjs; list:your-map rows are handed in as map_rows
start_here: Say to your AI: "Place my pursuits on my map of a full life and tell me which parts of my life none of them touch." It reads your map list and your pursuits from your lists, hands both to the tool, which places each pursuit on the areas it names and answers one line for every area nothing touches.

lists.label: Your map
lists.holds: The parts of your life your pursuits are placed on: one row per area, what it is part of and what it means to you.

instructions: 1. Pour the example areas into the list you keep your life areas in (see pour), or make list:your-map from them; the tool never reads the starter map in place of a map you did not choose.

2. Say "Place my pursuits on my life map"; your AI reads list:your-map rows and your pursuit records, then calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:place-pursuits-on-a-life-map, with pursuits [{title, areas: [area id]}], map_rows [{id, values}] and settings (the starter map), and section true for the Progress section.

3. Read the answer: areas lists every area with the pursuits placed on it, missing lists the leaf areas no pursuit names that are not optional, and missing_lines says each in one sentence; offered true means you have no map yet and nothing was placed.
4. Name the missing areas to a new or existing pursuit, or mark an area optional in your map, then run it again; the tool reads and keeps nothing.

worked_examples.title: One pursuit on the beds, the herbs left untouched
worked_examples.ask: Place my pursuits on my life map and tell me what I leave out.
worked_examples.given: From tools/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map/test/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map.test.mjs: the map_rows beds ("My beds", "what I planted") and herbs ("Herbs", "what I cook with") read from list:your-map, one pursuit "Grow beans" naming area beds, and the starter settings whose words say missing_one "Nothing you do tends your {label}.".
worked_examples.hands_back: offered false; areas [{id beds, label "My beds", pursuits ["Grow beans"]}, {id herbs, label "Herbs", pursuits []}] (each with its part_of, means and optional); missing [{id herbs, label "Herbs"}]; missing_lines ["Nothing you do tends your herbs."]. With no map_rows handed in the answer is {list_id: "your-map", offered: true} and nothing is placed.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
